## ♿ Accessibility & UX Checklist

Please verify that your contribution meets these standards:

- [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Used appropriate elements (e.g., `<button>` for actions, `<label>` for inputs).
- [ ] **ARIA Labels:** Added `aria-label` to icon-only buttons and descriptive labels where necessary.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation:** Ensured all interactive elements are focusable and have visible focus indicators.
- [ ] **Color Contrast:** Verified that text and UI elements have sufficient contrast for readability.
- [ ] **Bilingual Content:** Included both English and Bengali translations for all user-facing text.
- [ ] **Visual Feedback:** Provided feedback for interactions (e.g., loading states, hover states).
- [ ] **Accessible Media:** Added `alt` text to images and used `aria-hidden="true"` for decorative elements/emojis.
